blocks.prompt: 3. A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 12t - 36\) (m/s\(^2\)) and initial velocity \(v(0) = 30\) m/s. (a) Find the velocity function \(v(t)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh acceleration se velocity nikalne ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(a(t) = 12t - 36\) aur shuru ki velocity \(v(0) = 30\).
Rule kaunsa? Velocity ka derivative acceleration hai, to acceleration ko integrate karne se velocity milti hai (ek constant ke saath).
Plan: integrate, phir \(v(0) = 30\) se constant nikaalo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(a(t) = 12t - 36\), \(v(0) = 30\).
Maloom karna: \(v(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(v'(t) = a(t)\), is liye \(v\), \(a\) ka antiderivative hai; shuru ki velocity constant tay karegi.

Integrate karein
\[v(t) = \int (12t - 36)\,dt\]
\[= 12\cdot\dfrac{t^{2}}{2} - 36t + c = 6t^{2} - 36t + c\]
Kyun: power rule: \(\int t\,dt = \frac{t^{2}}{2}\), aur constant ka integral \(36t\).
Dhyan dein: \(+c\) mat bhooliye; isi ke baghair \(v(0) = 30\) wali shart poori nahin ho sakti.

\(v(0) = 30\) lagayein
\[30 = 6(0)^{2} - 36(0) + c \Rightarrow c = 30\]
\[v(t) = 6t^{2} - 36t + 30\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par baqi sab terms zero, sirf \(c\) bachta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[v'(t) = 12t - 36 = a(t)\;\checkmark, \quad v(0) = 30\;\checkmark\]
Derivative wapas acceleration deta hai aur shuru ki velocity bhi sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 3. A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 12t - 36\) (m/s\(^2\)) and initial velocity \(v(0) = 30\) m/s. (b) Find the displacement of the particle during the time period \(1 \le t \le 6\).
blocks.explanation:
Displacement ka matlab hai position mein kul tabdeeli, signs ke saath.
Diya kya hai? Part (a) wali \(v(t)\) aur waqt \(1 \le t \le 6\).
Rule kaunsa? \(\int_{t_1}^{t_2} v\,dt = s(t_2) - s(t_1)\).
Plan: \(v\) ko 1 se 6 tak integrate karo; yahan sign check karne ki zaroorat nahin, kyun ke displacement mein minus hissa minus hi ginna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(v(t) = 6t^{2} - 36t + 30\), interval \([1, 6]\).
Maloom karna: displacement \(s(6) - s(1)\).
Tareeqa: Fundamental Theorem: \(\int_{1}^{6} v(t)\,dt = s(6) - s(1)\).

Limits lagayein
\[F(6) = 432 - 648 + 180 = -36\]
\[F(1) = 2 - 18 + 30 = 14\]
\[\text{Displacement} = -36 - 14 = -50\]
Kyun: \(F(t) = 2t^{3} - 18t^{2} + 30t\); upar wali value minus neeche wali value. \(2(216) = 432\), \(18(36) = 648\).
Dhyan dein: \(-36 - 14\) mein dono minus hain, jawab \(-50\) hai, \(-22\) nahin.

Matlab aur tasdeeq
\(-50\) m ka matlab: \(t = 1\) wali jagah se particle aakhir mein 50 m left par hai. Part (c) ke tukre bhi yahi dete hain: \(-64 + 14 = -50\;\checkmark\).

blocks.prompt: 3. A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 12t - 36\) (m/s\(^2\)) and initial velocity \(v(0) = 30\) m/s. (c) Find the distance traveled during this time period.
blocks.explanation:
Ab distance poocha hai, yani chala hua kul raasta; is mein left aur right dono harkat plus ginni hai.
Diya kya hai? Wahi \(v(t)\) aur interval \([1, 6]\).
Rule kaunsa? Distance \(= \int |v|\,dt\).
Plan: \(v\) ko factorise kar ke dekho ke \([1, 6]\) ke andar sign kahan badalta hai; wahan interval toro aur negative hisse par \(-v\) lo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \([1, 6]\) par \(v(t) = 6t^{2} - 36t + 30\).
Maloom karna: kul distance \(\int_{1}^{6}|v(t)|\,dt\).
Tareeqa: \(v\) ke factors, har hisse par sign, aur jahan \(v < 0\) wahan \(-v\).

\(v\) ka sign
\[v(t) = 6(t^{2} - 6t + 5) = 6(t - 1)(t - 5)\]
\([1, 5]\) par \(v \le 0\) aur \([5, 6]\) par \(v \ge 0\).
Kyun: roots 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan \((t - 1) > 0\) aur \((t - 5) < 0\), to product negative; 5 ke baad dono positive. Misaal: \(t = 3\) par \(v = 6(2)(-2) = -24 < 0\).

Integral ko torein
\[\int_{1}^{6}|v|\,dt = -\int_{1}^{5}v\,dt + \int_{5}^{6}v\,dt\]
\[\int_{1}^{5}v\,dt = F(5) - F(1) = -50 - 14 = -64\]
\[\int_{5}^{6}v\,dt = F(6) - F(5) = -36 - (-50) = 14\]
Kyun: \(F(5) = 2(125) - 18(25) + 150 = 250 - 450 + 150 = -50\); \(F\) part (b) wala hai. Negative hisse ke aage minus laga kar use positive banaya.

Jama karein
\[\text{Distance} = 64 + 14 = 78\]
Kyun: pehle 64 m left gaya, phir 14 m right aaya; chala hua kul raasta dono ka jama.

Tasdeeq
Displacement \(= -64 + 14 = -50\), jo part (b) se milta hai; aur distance \(78 \ge 50\;\checkmark\).
